description: Use this when the user wants a table turned into an Excel spreadsheet (.xlsx) or a CSV file: "convert this PDF table to Excel", "make this into a spreadsheet", "export to CSV", "PDF to Excel", "screenshot to Excel". First read the table yourself from the uploaded file, image or text, then pass the header row and every data row exactly as written (keep currency signs and minus signs; do not total or reorder). Returns download links for .xlsx and .csv and a preview.

rows.description: Data rows, each an array of cell values in column order

title.description: What the table is, e.g. "March bank transactions" (used for the file name)

name: table_to_excel
title: Make an Excel or CSV file from a table
